description:
## Scope

After PKIX-emf1.1 through .6 land, re-run the diff harness end-to-end with CRL-aware chains and regenerate baseline-pkits.json.

## What

- Re-run pkix-difftest CLI against the PKITS corpus with revocation enabled.
- Compare new verdicts to current baseline (currently 'StricterThanWild' for §4.4 / §4.14 because pkix-path doesn't see the CRLs).
- Expected outcomes:
  - §4.4 (Separate Cert/CRL Keys): all three oracles agree on Pass/Fail.
  - §4.14 (Indirect CRL): pyca diverges or skips depending on the strategy from PKIX-emf1.4.
- Document at least one new divergence (or written-out justification that all agree).
- Update baseline-pkits-analysis.md to reflect the new buckets.

## Acceptance

- [ ] baseline-pkits.json regenerated.
- [ ] baseline-pkits-analysis.md updated with new CRL-related buckets.
- [ ] At least one new divergence documented (or written-out 'all agree' note for PKITS §4.4).

## Depends on

PKIX-emf1.1 .2 .3 .5 .6 (and .4's resolution for pyca).

## Parent

PKIX-emf1.
title: Regenerate baseline-pkits.json with CRL revocation enabled; document new divergences
